parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: 'query Today($from:String!,$to:String!,$learnerFirst:Int!){ events(first:100, filters:[{field:timeZonedEnd,operation:ge,value:$from},{field:timeZonedStart,operation:le,value:$to},{field:lifecycleState,operation:eq,value:"published"}]){ edges{ node{ id title type sessions{ edges{ node{ id title timeZonedStart timeZonedEnd } } } learners(first:$learnerFirst, filters:[{field:isCancelled,operation:eq,value:"false"}]){ edges{ node{ id contact{ id personalName{ firstName lastName } account{ name } } attendance{ sessionDetail{ edges{ node{ attendanceMark session{ id } } } } } } } pageInfo{ hasNextPage endCursor } } } } pageInfo{ hasNextPage } } }', variables: { from: $json.fromUtc, to: $json.toUtc, learnerFirst: Math.min(100, Math.max(1, parseInt(String($('Config').first().json.LEARNER_PAGE_SIZE || '100'), 10) || 100)) } }) }}

parameters.content:
## 5.0 Check-in Dashboard

A reception screen. One card per session running today, each showing three numbers:

- **Checked in** - learners Administrate holds as Present for that session. Read from Administrate, so it includes anyone staff marked by hand, not only QR scans.
- **Expected** - learners booked before the day, i.e. every active learner who is not a walk-in.
- **Walk-ins** - people 3.0 registered at the door for that session. Only the check-in log knows this, because Administrate cannot tell a door registration from any other.

A card turns green when everyone expected has checked in, a useful 'we could start early' signal. Clicking a number lists the names. The header shows when the page was built (in TIME_ZONE) and has a Refresh button on every view. The main view also reloads itself every REFRESH_SECONDS.

**Page address:** https://YOUR-N8N-HOST/webhook/<path of the Dashboard Page node> (also set as PAGE_URL in Config).

**Read-only.** Nothing here writes anywhere.

**ACCESS IS OPEN BY DEFAULT.** The page lists learner names, so set Authentication on the Dashboard Page node (e.g. Basic Auth) before using it for real, and do not share the URL publicly.

**Limits.** Reads up to 100 events overlapping today, and says so on the page if that limit is hit. Delegates are read 100 at a time. Plan Learner Pages picks out any event with more and works out the later pages (an Administrate cursor is 'Cursor:<row>' in base64, and n8n's own pagination cannot move a cursor inside a GraphQL body). Fetch More Learners reads them, up to LEARNER_MAX_PAGES pages per event. If an event still has more after that, or any page fails, the page names the event and warns that its numbers may be too low. Sessions with no delegates at all are left off.

## Config

**TIME_ZONE** - decides what 'today' means and how times are shown.
**REFRESH_SECONDS** - how often the page reloads itself.
**OPEN_MINUTES_BEFORE / CLOSE_HOURS_AFTER** - used only to label each card 'opens at', 'open' or 'closed'. They must match 3.0's values of the same names, which are what actually control check-in.
**PAGE_URL / PAGE_TITLE** - this page's own address (for its links) and heading. Replace YOUR-N8N-HOST in PAGE_URL.
**GRAPHQL_URL** - Administrate endpoint.
**CHECKIN_LOG_TABLE_ID** - id of the EventCheckInLog Data Table that 3.0 writes.
**LEARNER_PAGE_SIZE** - delegates read per request. 100 is Administrate's maximum and the right value; a smaller number only makes paging easy to test.
**LEARNER_MAX_PAGES** - most pages of delegates read per event, first page included. 5 = up to 500 at 100 a page. Every page up to this number is requested for an event that has more than one page, so do not raise it without reason. An event with more still gets a warning on the page.

Also select your Administrate OAuth2 credential on Fetch Todays Events and Fetch More Learners.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: 'query MoreLearners($id:String!,$after:String,$learnerFirst:Int!){ events(filters:[{field:id,operation:eq,value:$id}]){ edges{ node{ id learners(first:$learnerFirst, after:$after, filters:[{field:isCancelled,operation:eq,value:"false"}]){ edges{ node{ id contact{ id personalName{ firstName lastName } account{ name } } attendance{ sessionDetail{ edges{ node{ attendanceMark session{ id } } } } } } } pageInfo{ hasNextPage endCursor } } } } } }', variables: { id: $json.eventId, after: $json.after, learnerFirst: Math.min(100, Math.max(1, parseInt(String($('Config').first().json.LEARNER_PAGE_SIZE || '100'), 10) || 100)) } }) }}
